okr.objective: Fedelm names several heroic Irish women and goddesses.
key_results: Several Irish women bear the name Fedelm.
The seer of Cruachan met Queen Medb before the cattle raid.
The princess of Connacht met Saint Patrick at a spring.
The name may mean a woman prophet.
